description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useSocket' that manages a Socket.IO client connection, providing connection status, subscription, and emission capabilities within a React application.

methods.name: useSocket(namespace = '/')
methods.description: A React hook that initializes and manages a Socket.IO client connection, providing access to the socket instance, connection status, and helper functions for subscribing and emitting events.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: A function to subscribe to a socket event, returning an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: A function to emit an event with a payload through the socket connection.
